entries.title: E2E — all API endpoints headless (Bearer)
entries.summary: Playwright spec exercises every /api/* route with envelope checks and profile/grievance/structure CRUD smoke. npm run test:e2e:api:headless; api-client.ts helpers.

entries.title: API success responses unified via apiSuccess()
entries.summary: All App/Controllers/Api/* success paths use apiSuccess(); no raw json() in Api layer. Profile/Grievance/ApiController manual fixes; cli/refactor_api_success.php codemod.

entries.title: API standardized error codes and mobile registry
entries.summary: ApiErrorCode + Controller apiSuccess/apiError; all Api controllers refactored; GET /api/meta/error-codes; auth/me capabilities; GET /api/grievance/options; docs/API_ERROR_CODES.md.
entries.area: App/ApiErrorCode.php; App/ApiErrorRegistry.php; Core/Controller.php; App/Controllers/Api/*; public/index.php; docs/*

entries.title: Mobile app integration guide (MOBILE_APP_INTEGRATION.md)
entries.summary: Docs for third-party/mobile clients: auth, capabilities, location picker flow, profile/structure/grievance API examples, multipart uploads, limitations. Linked from README and API_CONTRACT.

entries.title: Municipality findOrCreateByName assigns MUN-AUTO code
entries.summary: findOrCreateByName no longer inserts NULL code; uses TMP insert + MUN-AUTO-{id} update and ensureAutoCode for legacy rows. Fixes E2E_DB_SEED / seed_projects_users_field_team.php after municipalities.code NOT NULL.

entries.title: Full application headless E2E suite
entries.summary: Serial Playwright spec covers login, dashboard UI + /api/dashboard, profile create/list, grievance create/list, structure/users headings, and grievance respondents shell. Bootstraps Library project/municipality/barangay when DB has none. npm scripts test:e2e:full:headless and test:e2e:full:headless:seed; BASE_URL from playwright.config.ts.
entries.tests: npm run test:e2e:full:headless | npm run test:e2e:full:headless:seed
